Title: AI Proxy
ShortDescription: A transparent inspector and rule engine for AI API traffic. Sits between your AI clients (Claude Code, Copilot Chat, Cursor, raw SDKs) and upstreams like Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, or vLLM - logging every request, tool call, and token count, applying configurable rules, and showing it all in a live local web dashboard.
Description:
AI Proxy is a transparent inspector and rule engine that sits between your AI clients (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Chat, Cursor, raw SDKs) and their upstreams (Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, anything OpenAI-compatible). Point your client's base URL at the proxy and every request, response, tool call, token count, and conversation thread is captured automatically - no client changes required. A live web dashboard runs locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/__proxy/.

OBSERVE
• Inspect every request - full bodies, headers, streaming chunks, tool calls, token counts, and latency, searchable and filterable by client app.
• Group requests into conversations automatically, with a turn-by-turn timeline, in-conversation search, and message-type filters.
• Watch traffic live - one tile per active conversation, with elapsed time and token counts updating as the model generates.
• Identify the client app (Claude Code, VS Code Copilot Chat, Cursor, Continue, Cline, SDKs, and more) via fingerprinting.
• Track artifacts - files, URLs, directories, and images the model touched through tool calls, browsable by conversation or folder.
• Aggregate stats - per-model, per-client, per-app, and per-tool counts, tokens, latency percentiles, and trend charts.
• System metrics - CPU, memory, GPU utilization and VRAM, and loaded models on Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM.

INTERVENE
• Translate Anthropic and OpenAI API shapes in both directions, so Claude Code can talk to any OpenAI-compatible backend (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM).
• Route requests across models and upstreams with conditional rules on model name, prompt size, tool presence, image presence, client IP, or path.
• Pluggable rule pipeline - pre-flight and post-flight rules with a JSON editor and quick-toggle UI. Changes apply on the next request; no restart.
• Compress bloated context, guard against silent context-window truncation, validate and auto-fix malformed tool calls, and block tool-call loops.
• Shadow runs - send the same request to a primary upstream and a local model in parallel and get an automatic side-by-side comparison.
• Take control - kill a stuck in-flight request to free the GPU, or flip panic mode to stop all proxied traffic while keeping the dashboard up.

AUTOMATE
• Auditor suggestions - the proxy analyzes recent traffic and recommends configuration changes.
• Benchmarks - compare models on speed and correctness, sweeping models, context sizes, thinking modes, and temperatures in one submission.
• Scheduled tasks - queue a prompt to run one-shot or on a schedule, with pause, resume, and run-now controls.
• MCP server - exposes the captured data via the Model Context Protocol, so an LLM can query traffic patterns directly.

Runs entirely on your machine: a single local process with SQLite-backed storage and no build step. PII redaction is on by default for viewers on other subnets. There is no built-in authentication - bind to 127.0.0.1 for local-only use. Open source (MIT): github.com/guscatalano/AI_Proxy
Features: Inspect every AI API request: full bodies, headers, streaming chunks, tool calls, token counts, and latency
Live local dashboard with automatic conversation threading and real-time token counts
Translate Anthropic and OpenAI API shapes so Claude Code can use any OpenAI-compatible backend
Route requests across models and upstreams (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) with conditional rules
Rule pipeline that blocks tool-call loops, fixes malformed tool calls, and compresses bloated context
Shadow runs: compare a primary upstream against a local model side by side
Benchmarks, usage stats, system metrics, scheduled tasks, and an MCP server for querying traffic
